correctness.rationale: All quantifiers q>=2,n>=1 and exact occurrence conventions handled. The reflection-union forest proof establishes full two-center event independence; tail events imply pairwise independent radius counts. Geometric sums give the rational variance GF and O_q(1) error. A standard-library verifier independently checks 24668 forest cases, 27 complete word-space variances, and 474 rational coefficient identities.

value.rationale: Pairwise independence despite heavy interval overlap, together with demonstrable failure of three-wise independence, is a nontrivial structural property of random strings. The exact all-n all-q variance generating function calibrates palindrome-occurrence scans and is independent of distinct-factor complexity; the problem is a natural second-moment invariant rather than an arbitrary computational slice.
